Initial release of Create AI Video for Marketing.

- Instantly generate professional marketing videos from your images or footage with a simple prompt—no editing experience needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG uploads (up to 500MB); outputs 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- Seamless cloud processing with automatic token/session setup (includes free credits for new users).
- Features text overlays, background music, multi-track timeline support, and export workflow.
- Built-in error handling for authentication, file size, format, and balance issues.
- Clear, action-based chat interaction—just upload assets and tell it what you want.
